messages:
aisha (Finance Ops): Heads up — Sirocco Labs (acct SIR-442) just hit 45 days past due for invoice INV-2024-09-88, amount $148,320. No response to 2nd dunning email. Thinking merchant hold on provisioning next week unless we get a payment plan today.

daniel (Acct Mgmt): Ack. They've been scaling quickly this quarter. Have we tried schedule call? I pinged their CFO last week, no reply.

kofi (Revenue Ops): If we push a hard hold we risk losing the deal. Suggest offering a 3-installment payment plan with immediate 25% payment and autopay mandate.

aisha (Finance Ops): Agreed on 3x. Proposed terms in thread: 25% today, 37.5% in 30 days, 37.5% in 60 days. No product changes until first payment posts.

.billing-bot: Payment status: invoice INV-2024-09-88 — DUE 45d — balance $148,320 — last payment attempt ACH failed (R03). See logs: 
```
payment_attempts: 3
last_attempt: 2024-11-02T15:03:12Z
failure_code: R03 (invalid_account)
```

daniel (Acct Mgmt): They had an ACH return? Oof. Can we offer card-on-file as backup? I can push a personal contact.

aisha (Finance Ops): Card is risky at that volume. We should require wire or ACH plus autopay. If they accept, I'll draft payment schedule and update contract amendment.

emily (Legal): If we move forward with a payment plan, add clause: "missed installment triggers immediate termination and full balance acceleration" + recovery of collection costs. Also need exec approval for reducing entitlement.

kofi (Revenue Ops): Fine to add that clause. Approve the 3x plan with acceleration clause. We should cap collection fee at 15%.

aisha (Finance Ops): Cool. I'll send a short called-out email with terms and 48-hour deadline, copy legal. Draft below — please confirm edits: 
```
Sirocco Labs — Payment Plan Proposal
Invoice: INV-2024-09-88
Total: $148,320
Payment schedule:
  - 25% ($37,080) due within 48 hours of acceptance (wire/confirmed ACH)
  - 37.5% ($55,620) due +30 days
  - 37.5% ($55,620) due +60 days
Terms: Missed installment = immediate acceleration of full outstanding balance; 15% collection fee and interest at 1.5%/mo on overdue amounts. Services suspended until first payment posts.
Reply to accept or request a call within 48 hours.
```

daniel (Acct Mgmt): Language looks good. Maybe soften "suspended" to "paused for billable features" — less abrasive for their CS team.

emily (Legal): "Paused for billable features" is fine. Keep acceleration and collection fee as-is.

aisha (Finance Ops): Updated and sent at 2024-11-10T17:12Z. Tagging @kofi to escalate if no reply by 48h.

kofi (Revenue Ops): Will escalate to my CRO if no reply. Also prepping a short note to sales leadership to pause outbound enablement for their account.

billing-bot: Note added to account SIR-442: "Payment plan offered 2024-11-10; 48h response window; services to be paused pending initial payment."

daisha (typo): (ignore)

aisha (Finance Ops): Correction: tagging @kofi and @daniel — please report back with any acceptance or wire confirmation.

last action: 2024-11-12T09:00Z — no reply received; kofi: will call their CFO this morning and update thread.
